Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

reply.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We are following up on our revised offer sent recently, as we have not yet received your response. For your reference, our Angebot stands at a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. In line with our standard policy, this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please let us know if you have any questions or if we can proceed with the proposed terms. We look forward to your prompt feedback.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor [n19514] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
Our latest forecast for part:350011 grows +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your increased volume forecast and have incorporated this into our revised calculation.
As you indicated a willingness to pay faster for a better price, we have adjusted the payment terms back to 30 days net to offer you a more favourable rate.
Our colleagues will provide the requested information regarding the cost breakdown shortly.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.02 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
